exposure: women who did not have bladder injuries
size of the uterine incision extension
failed vacuum attempt prior to cesarean delivery
women diagnosed with urinary bladder injury
finding: Urinary bladder adhesions, failed vacuum attempt prior to cesarean delivery, and size of uterine incision extension are independent risk factors for urinary bladder injury during cesarean delivery.
mod_finding: This study investigates risk factors for urinary bladder injury during cesarean delivery.
